Maria Chen: Heads-up — PR #21455 (pkg/inference/streaming) queued for merge but stage CI failing. test: model-serving/e2e_streaming_integration_test::streaming_no_block_timeout flapping on stage-2-windows (timeout + snapshot mismatch). Holding merge.

ci-bot: Build 21455-stage-2/windows — FAILED (exit 137). Logs uploaded: https://ci.redwood.example/21455/build/err

Samir Patel: @Maria Chen can you paste the failing stack/log snippet?

Maria Chen: sure, copied the tail of the failing test log:
```
[RUN] model-serving/e2e_streaming_integration_test::streaming_no_block_timeout
elapsed=31.2s deadline=30s
ERROR: snapshot mismatch at /tmp/snapshots/stream-001.png
stack: serve::stream::flush_buffers -> runtime::kv::flush_at_commit
```

Linda Gomez: I believe the timeout is from the new buffered-flush change. Repro locally? If not, we should targeted-rerun the failing shard and check artifacts.

Alex Wu: kicked off targeted rerun: `/buildkite rerun --pr 21455 --shard=stage-2-windows-3`

ci-bot: Rerun queued as job 21455-rt-3 — status: running

Alex Wu: rerun finished — job 21455-rt-3 PASSED, but snapshot diff remains (tiny visual drift). Diff artifact: https://ci.redwood.example/21455/artifacts/diff.png

Priya Kaur: small visual drift — looks like antialiasing/font fallback. I can approve snapshot update if the test owner agrees. @Maria Chen please confirm.

Maria Chen: Confirm — change in rasterization due to font fallback tweak is expected. I'll update the golden to accept the new raster.

Samir Patel: LGTM on the snapshot change from a product perspective. @Priya Kaur you can approve once the golden is updated.

Priya Kaur: Approved after snapshot update. Marked PR as ready-to-merge.

Linda Gomez: Let's hold the actual merge until nightly completes (we saw a similar flake yesterday). Holding for 3 hours to be safe.

Maria Chen: Ack — adding merge-hold tag and note in the PR. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
